intro: Walking home you encounter a strange storm. Intense lightning makes you
seek cover. Up ahead you see an old library. It doesn't look open but you
might be able to take cover on the porch. You try the door and are
surprised to find it unlocked. You open the door and slip inside.

stage1_vestibule: You hear the door slam shut behind you and the lock slide into place.
You try the handle but the door is locked. You find yourself in a
large entryway. The library is strangely deserted but there are books
and papers strewn about. You have a bad feeling about this...
stage1_vestibule_respawn: Oh no! Died so soon? Where is the fun in that. Let's try this again.
Shrieking into the dark didn't work out so well, did it?
You're stuck in the Vestibule. Maybe look around before you get us
stage1_vestibule_searched: The vestibule is mostly empty except for some books and newspapers.
You spot a backpack on the floor over by an overturned mop bucket,
the mop lying on the floor next to the puddle of water as though
whoever was using left in a hurry. Maybe you should check that pack

No weapons though. That mop looks pretty sturdy and might com in

stage1_turnstile_check: As you approach the turnstyles and look into the foyer past the
circulation desk, you think you see something moving down low to
the floor...something big, with a tail. Maybe you should grab that
stage1_mop_acquired: You turn back and grab the mop, it's wooden handle feels solid in
your hands. It's not your first choice because it's still wet from
mopping, but it's better than nothing.
stage2_foyer: You hop over the turnstiles and find yourself in the foyer near the
stage2_foyer_searched: The room is large and although there are large stained glass windows,
the papers and books scattered on the floor are shrouded in gloom.
In front of you is a large semicurcular circulation desk. Just out of
site appears to be a dead body, the leg of a woman wearing jeans is
to the left of the circulation desk. Beyond the circulation desk is
the periodicals section. There are several rows of chest height shelves
with stands to hold newspapers. The newspapers are scattered all over
floor. Whatever happened here made quite the mess.
stage2_corpse_looted: You've never been a fan of dead bodies (who is), but if the woman was
the librarian she might have a key to the front door. You approach the
body slowly. She's wearing a dress with no pockets, why don't they put
pockets in more womens clothes? Next to her arm you see her purse. Inside
you find [INVENTORY]. No key, but this stuff might come in handy.
stage2_desk_looted: The circulation desk is mostly empty, surprising for a library. There's no
computers of any kind. How are they checking out the books? There's almost
nothing on the desk and the drawers are empty. Hanging on a hook is a key
labeled 'stacks'. Not the front door key, but maybe the stacks will lead
stage2_both_looted: There's nothing else here except all these newspapers on the ground. They're
all yellowed with age. You pick one up, 1802. Maybe this was an archive of
some kind. You don't see a way out from here, but maybe there's something on
the other side of the room.
stage2_periodicals_check: You walk into the periodicals section, moving slowly, extremely aware of the
sounds of your footsteps crinkling the newspaper under your feet. You try not
to step on them, but you can't help it. They're all from 1802. What kind of
library is this? You stop because you hear something moving in the rows between
the shelves. You can't see it, You don't know if you want to, but there is defnitely
something big crawling down the next aisle.

stage2_reading_room_locked: You try the handle, careful not to make too much noise. It doesn't move, it must be
stage2_fireplace_revealed: A little ahead of you, you see an antique fireplace.
stage2_poker_acquired: In a small black stand next to the hearth, you see a fireplace poker. I looks like
a much more formidable weapon than your mop, so you gently rest the mop against
the bricks and pick up the fireplace poker.
stage2_stacks_door_check: Up ahead you see a red door marked 'STACKS'.
stage2_stacks_door_locked_no_key: You approach the door and try the handle but the door is locked. You don't have
a key. You're about to turn around when you hear something large come up behind
stage2_respawn_no_mop: You wake up back on the wrong side of the turnstiles, bruised and deeply
disappointed in your life choices. Wandering unarmed into a darkened
library was ambitious, but stupid. Grab that wet mop by the bucket
stage2_respawn_no_key: You sit up behind the circulation desk, rubbing the back of your neck.
Throwing yourself against a locked iron door with a creature on your heels
is a great way to end up on the evening news. You need that Stacks key.
stage2_reading_room_door_respawn: You peel yourself up off the floor outside the double doors, ears still
ringing. Panicking and violently rattling brass handles in a silent,
monster-infested library is an excellent way to get yourself killed.
Be quiet. Try the lock gently.
stage3_hub_unexplored: You are at the unexplored main hub of the stacks.
stage3_foyer_blocked: You try to retreat toward the foyer, but you find the monster from earlier waiting for you near the door, forcing you back into the stacks.
stage3_hub: You are at the main hub of the stacks. Dimly lit aisles stretch ahead.
stage3_death_choice: You have died in the stacks.
stage3_row1_encounter: You reach the heavy glass door leading into the reading room. Looking through the glass reveals unmistakable evidence of a creature lurking inside.
stage3_row2_encounter: You are in a dim corridor. A fallen figure lies on the floor ahead.
stage3_row2_looted: You have searched the corpse and gathered what you could. The corridor stretches into darkness ahead.
stage3_row2_dark_warning: It looks dark ahead. I wonder if there's a lightswitch somewhere back there.
stage3_row4_encounter: You move into a cramped, narrow aisle choked with shelving. A discarded backpack rests against a shelf.
stage3_row4_looted: You have looted the pack. Looking around, the aisle feels tight, suffocating, and claustrophobic.
stage3_row5_warning: Your hair stands on end. There is something profoundly unnatural about the darkness down this row.
stage4_entry: You enter the deep stacks maze.
stage4_death_choice: You have died in the deep stacks maze.
stage4_junction_c: You are at Junction C (The Torn Tapestry).
stage4_junction_c_check: You check for a pocketknife at the tapestry.
stage4_junction_e: You are at Junction E (The Electrical Hazard).
stage4_junction_f: You are at Junction F (The Monster's Nest).
stage4_structural_hub: You have reached the Structural Hub (End of Maze).

stage5_mezzanine_death_choice: You have died on the mezzanine.
stage5_balcony_door: You reach the exterior balcony door.
stage5_mezzanine_umbrella_check: You check your umbrella in the stairwell trap.
stage5_basement_arrival: You arrive at the basement stairs.
stage5_basement_death_choice: You have died in the basement.
stage5_basement_umbrella_check: You check for the umbrella in the basement.
stage5_occult_archive_entry: You reach dry concrete in the Occult Archive.
stage5_occult_archive_hub: You are at the Occult Archive Hub.
stage5_both_tested_hub: You have fully explored the archive hub.
stage5_cave_approach_final: You approach the final cave exit.

stage1_vestibule__try_to_leave: You turn and grab the door handle. You have to get out of here. The door won't budge.
You panic and yell out 'Somebody help me!' You bang loudly on the door hoping to
catch the attention of a passerby. You're so busy banging on the door you don't
notice that the sound has gotten the attention of something lurking in the library.
It jumps on your back and kills you. You die never knowing what it was.
stage2_foyer__go_deeper: You walk into the dimly lit foyer, past the circulation desk towrds
the shelves of books. You're looking at the windows for one that opens
so you don't see the body on the floor. You trip and fall flat on your
face. When you roll to your side to get back up, you see a reptile like
creature low on the ground coming at you with surprising speed. You try
to get up but you aren't fast enough. It pounces on you and you're dead
before you know what hit you.
stage2_reading_room_door__rattle_reading: The door is locked. Frustrated, you grab both handles and pull
hard, shaking the door in its frame. You hear a noise behind you.
The monster you heard earlier is 5 feet away, drawn by the noise,
its approach masked by your panicked rattling of the door. It eats
stage2_stacks_door_locked_no_key__defend: You turn to face the monster but before you can swing your weapon,
it pounces. You're dead, but at least the monster isn't hungry anymore.
stage2_stacks_door_locked_no_key__slowly: You back away slowly. 'Nice hideous monster' you say in a soothing voice.
Nice or not, it's hungry and it eats you. You die.
stage3_arrival__with_mop_check: You tripped over the unwieldy mop while trying to swing at the creature, resulting in a fatal fall.
stage3_hub_unexplored__go_deeper: You rushed blindly into the stacks without looking around, and something waiting in the shadows struck instantly.

stage3_hub__go_down_row_2__else: You attempt to go down row 2 without peering first and are attacked.
stage3_hub__go_down_row_3: Something lurking just out of sight in the middle path killed you.
stage3_hub__go_down_row_4__else: You attempt to go down row 4 without peering first and are attacked.
stage3_hub__go_down_row_5: You ventured into the unnatural blackness of row 5. You never even saw what killed you.
stage3_row1_encounter__enter_the_reading: Something giant and frightening inside the reading room killed you.
stage3_row2_dark_warning__go_deeper: Refusing to heed the warning, you tried to navigate the dark corridor without your flashlight, and something in the shadows got you in the pitch black.
stage3_row4_encounter__go_deeper: The thing lurking in row 3 ambushed you when you reached the end of row 4.
stage3_row4_looted__go_deeper: The thing lurking in row 3 ambushed you when you reached the end of row 4.
stage3_row5_warning__peer: You peer into row 5 a second time. Everything goes completely black before you can react, and you don't know what killed you.
